tools.name: PowerShell 7 tools (tools/)

runtime_boundary: Game build 10034136 (days_gone_classic), zz_Karin_P.pak in BendGame/Content/Paks/~mods with sfpaks/startuppackages.pak renamed to disabled_startuppackages.pak. Project builds made with the original scripts ran in game on the test machine: Karin visible with textures (t5), expressions in photo mode confirmed by the user (t10), physics judged good by the user (t27), blink checked from in-game frames (t29), lip sync judged good by the user (t30), and t31 (pak sha256 87576aec..., reduced hair swing) judged fine by the user. Known issue: in photo mode the right twin-tail AnimDynamics chain stretches into a sheet; gameplay is normal. The portable copies were checked offline only (2026-10-16): make_pak.py run with Blender's Python reproduces the t31 pak byte for byte (with Python 3.14 the staged files match and only the zlib-ng compressed bytes differ); abp_springs.py, blink_amp.py, skel_retarget.py and lid_calib.py reproduce the t31 / t30 / t10 / t28 outputs; build_body.py, face_rig.py, blink_rig.py and mouth_rig.py reproduce the t7 / t11 / t29 / t30 reports (see VALIDATION.md). The UE 4.11 import and cook, DgExport and the install were not re-run with the kit; the PowerShell tools ran only with a fake DgExport and temporary folders.
python: 3.10+ for the pak and package tools (standard library); numpy 2.5 (3.12+) for the others; Blender scripts run in Blender's Python 3.11; tested 3.14.0 and Blender 4.2's 3.11.7 (numpy 1.24.3)
dependency_install: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt -r portable-kits/days-gone/requirements.txt (from bundle root)
